headline: Zero-day blocks Windows Defender antivirus updates
summary: A new zero-day exploit released by researcher Abdelhamid Naceri, known as Nightmare Eclipse, leaves Microsoft Defender running but unable to install updates.

claims.statement: A new zero-day exploit blocks Microsoft Defender from installing updates.

sources.quote: New Windows Defender zero-day blocks Microsoft antivirus updates
leaves Microsoft's antivirus running but unable to install updates

claims.statement: The exploit was released by researcher Abdelhamid Naceri, also known as Nightmare Eclipse.

claims.statement: The Register names the exploit BigDiskBuster.
